event.title: Judge Says Search Warrants for Former Prince Andrew's Property Were Unlawful
event.canonical_title: Judge Says Search Warrants for Former Prince Andrew's Property Were Unlawful
event.summary: British police have admitted that the search warrants issued to investigate properties linked to Andrew Mountbatten-Windsor were unlawful and must be quashed. A London judge confirmed this ruling, although the investigation into the younger brother of King Charles II remains ongoing. Andrew was arrested on February 19 on suspicion of misconduct in public office.

timeline.title: Judge Says Search Warrants for Former Prince Andrew's Property Were Unlawful
timeline.summary: A judge has stated that the search warrants used to seize property from former Prince Andrew were unlawful. The statement indicates that police made a significant error in the application process for the warrants.
key_facts: Warrants were related to property seized from former Prince Andrew
